memories.summary: The built-in connector catalog is intended to be definition-first. Review classifier output, proof-gate metadata, and sourcegen dry-run status before accepting hand-written runtime work.
Source runtime coverage changes should preserve catalog coverage dimensions, read/discover fixture pairs, pagination boundaries, cursor/freshness semantics, and projector registration.
Control selection, rule coverage, posture, and auditor evidence packets should share the compliance package matching logic instead of growing parallel mapping paths.
Security-agent behavior should start from bounded evidence packets, verifier status, connector gates, tenant scope, eval fixtures, and explicit action-stage limits.
The release train is high cadence. Post-merge tooling should distinguish failed checks from expected tag lag, and should always show whether the latest release tag includes the merged commit.
